title: Immune Activation & Latent Viral Vigilance Protocol
plain_language_summary: Elevated leukocyte shift, increased circulating inflammatory cytokines, or elevated latent viral marker index detected.
crew_instructions: Verify environmental closed-loop air filtration and UV sterilization status in crew quarters.
Perform secondary saliva collection for viral DNA shedding quantification (EBV/VZV/HSV-1 panel).
Initiate standardized 8-hour sleep recovery window; suspend high-intensity physical training for 24 hours.
Log thermal profile and notify crew medical officer for non-invasive symptom tracking.
de_escalation_criteria: Inflammatory cytokine markers return to within 1.5 sigma of personal baseline, normal thermal log for 48 hours.
